method: AB-H/AB-R, temporal provenance and assertion-type audit
prior: RC05: 10/09/2026 designation act, Senado mandate 11/09/2026, appointment bulletin published 16/09/2026, first_public_at exact unknown.
pre_exposure: Before this prereg, a public search disclosed the CCyL prior candidate acceptance BOCCL 32/12 ESE/000002-01 published 10/09/2026 and signed 03/09/2026. This is a specifically targeted post-discovery test, NOT blind confirmatory evidence.
question: Does an earlier official nominative bulletin distinguish candidate nomination from legal senator designation, defeating date-only/as-of join of the RC05 individuals?
H1: Prior bulletin records proposal and acceptance of candidacies, not election/designation; official 16/09 publication uniquely reports plenary designation on 10/09.
H0: Prior bulletin already certifies selection as senators or a contemporary dated original makes legal designation public by cut 12/09.
alternatives: A transcript from plenary session dated 10/09 may document the vote but original public release time unknown.
Senate membership effective from 11/09 may be visible now but was not necessarily public by 12/09.
frozen_sample: Senate individual Maroto, Martín García, Iglesias García

test.compare: For each original quote operative verb, date signed, date on official publication, time of legal effect if reported; separate information available from publication-date proxy from first_public_at exact; never infer original publication time from crawl time.
test.negative_control: A dated nomination notice must not confer designated-senator label; designation bulletin published after cut 2026-09-12 must not be used to backtest as-of cut.

acceptance: Two distinct official announcement types corroborated, date proxy rules and explicit leakage exclusion; no promotion of first_public_at.
stop: R5 if independent timestamp archive absent and same-day exact timing cannot be obtained; no new broad searches on same names.
